body: **Foco:** Laboratório de exame 22 (TOEFL · IELTS · college).
**Pronúncia:** Redução de palavras funcionais (to, of, for, and, can).
**20 palavras novas** (ciência).
**Texto do dia:** notícia / reportagem curta.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo treinar a tarefa de falar resumindo uma notícia científica, como no TOEFL Speaking.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Report: Astronomers Spot a Distant Planet
paras: A team of astronomers **announced** on Tuesday that they had spotted a planet about twice the size of Earth orbiting a nearby star. The planet, found with a space telescope, **is thought to** have water vapor in its atmosphere.
“It is too early to say whether life exists there,” said lead scientist Dr. Alves, who **added** that more observations **are needed**. The finding **was published** in a leading journal.

items.q: The planet is about twice the size of Earth.
Scientists have confirmed life on the planet.
The finding was published in a journal.

blocks.body: No TOEFL Speaking, resuma em **4 frases**: **o que aconteceu**, **um detalhe**, **uma ressalva** e **o próximo passo**. Use verbos de relato: **announce, add, say**.

items.s: Astronomers ___ that they had spotted a planet. (announce, past)
The planet is ___ to have water vapor. (think, part.)
Dr. Alves ___ that more observations are needed. (add, past)
The finding was ___ in a journal. (publish, part.)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Yes event detail caveat next step
items.pt: Sim: evento, detalhe, ressalva, próximo passo.

body: **Out of this world.** — Extraordinário.
**Over the moon.** — Nas nuvens.
**Reach for the stars.** — Mirar alto.
**Once in a blue moon.** — Muito raramente.
**Early days.** — Ainda é cedo.
**Shed light on.** — Esclarecer.
**Yes: event, detail, caveat, next step.** — Sim: evento, detalhe, ressalva, próximo passo.
**Astronomers announced that they found a planet.** — Astrônomos anunciaram que encontraram um planeta.
**Good. Now add a caveat.** — Bom. Agora acrescente uma ressalva.

prompts.model: Astronomers announced that they found a planet.
It is thought to have water vapor.

blocks.model: Astronomers announced that they found a planet twice the size of Earth. It is thought to have water vapor in its atmosphere. The lead scientist added that it is too early to say whether life exists there. More observations are needed.

body: TOEFL Speaking: resumo de 45–60 s; organize em evento, detalhe, ressalva, próximo passo.
Use verbos de relato variados (announce, add, point out).
Fale em ritmo constante; corrija-se sem parar.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
